title: @tool script auto-executes disk write and force-quits the editor process off a lingering --editor-preview-shot user arg
detail: Any editor launch retaining this user arg auto-runs tool code that moves the viewport camera, writes a file, and get_tree().quit() kills the whole interactive editor — potential loss of unsaved scene work.
recommended_fix: Gate the auto-run on an explicit second unattended flag (or detect a non-interactive capture session) and log loudly before quitting; never implicitly quit an interactive editor.
